III. Chapter on Developing

Pages 902–902 (1 pages)
Yamaka III. Chapter on Developing p. 902

Faultless dhamma had not arisen at this person at this plane. Will indeterminate dhamma not cease at that person at that plane? (They) will cease. Indeterminate dhamma will not cease at this person at this plane. Had faultless dhamma not arisen at that person at that plane? (They) had arisen.

Un-faultless dhamma had not arisen at this person at this plane. 228. Will indeterminate dhamma not cease at that person at that plane? (They) will cease. Indeterminate dhamma will not cease at this person at this plane. Had un-faultless dhamma not arisen at that person at that plane? (They) had arisen.

End of Chapter on Origination and Cessation (Uppādanirodha Vāro) End of Process Chapter Pavattivāro niṭṭhito

III. Chapter on Developing (Bhāvanā Vāra)

This person develops faultless dhamma. Does that person abandon 229. un-faultless dhamma? Yes. This person abandons un-faultless dhamma. Does that person develop faultless dhamma? Yes. This person does not develop faultless dhamma. Does that person not abandon un-faultless dhamma? Yes. This person does not abandon un-faultless dhamma. Does that person not develop faultless dhamma? Yes. ...pe ...

End of Chapter on Developing (Bhāvanā Vāro)

End of Dhamma Yamaka.

Dhamma Yamaka Pāḷi Nit. t. hita.
